commonVariables.independentUnit: one independently seeded training run; episodes and turns are repeated observations within that run
commonVariables.taskSuccess: binary correct task outcome per evaluation episode with learning disabled
commonVariables.positiveSignaling: change in sender message distribution across relevant sender observations
commonVariables.positiveListening: change in receiver action distribution caused by a message intervention while receiver observation and policy state are held fixed
commonVariables.ledgerPrediction: action distribution or signed intervention direction committed from the private ledger before the intervention outcome is generated
commonVariables.ledgerIncrementalValue: held-out improvement in proper prediction score over the strongest preregistered non-ledger comparator
commonVariables.stableConvention: a preregistered rolling window meeting both form-use consistency and causal-listening thresholds
commonVariables.compositionalGeneralization: success on untouched attribute combinations with learning disabled plus sensitivity to registered part/order interventions
commonVariables.leakage: recoverable information about a forbidden target from a field or channel after conditioning on its allowed information set
commonVariables.replacementDegradation: held-in-partner success minus new-partner success for the same training seed
commonVariables.invalidRun: a run failing a preregistered integrity, configuration, gateway, or infrastructure validity rule; it remains in accounting

confirmatoryFamily.procedure: Compute one valid preregistered p-value per member, then apply Holm across all nine members. A composite directional hypothesis uses the maximum component p-value and requires every component direction and effect threshold. No alpha is recycled from deterministic qualification gates.
confirmatoryFamily.validityGate: E00-E03 and every experiment-specific integrity gate must pass before the corresponding member is confirmatory. A failed or missing gate yields not-tested, not a favorable or unfavorable p-value.

graph.kind: interpretation gate; null results remain reportable

hypotheses.estimand: Mean held-out success difference between a frozen trained normal channel and each seed-paired disabled, constant, random, and shuffled delivery control.
hypotheses.decision: All four one-sided contrasts must exceed the registered minimum effect; use the maximum component p-value before global Holm.

hypotheses.estimand: Mean within-case change in receiver probability assigned to the ledger-predicted action under a ledger-consistent substitution versus a seed-matched shuffled valid message, with receiver observation and pre-intervention policy state fixed.
hypotheses.decision: The lower simultaneous interval must exceed the registered minimum causal effect after global Holm.

hypotheses.estimand: Mean seed-level held-out compositional-generalization difference: 32-symbol/4-token minus 128-symbol/8-token under matched model, exposure, update, and compute budgets.
hypotheses.decision: The one-sided contrast must exceed the registered minimum effect after global Holm.

hypotheses.estimand: Held-out paired improvement in preregistered proper prediction score for the pre-outcome ledger model versus the strongest eligible transcript-only, task-history, policy-state, random, and majority baseline.
hypotheses.decision: The lower simultaneous interval for improvement over the selected baseline must exceed zero and the registered practical threshold after global Holm.

hypotheses.estimand: Conjunction of blank-carrier stable-form rate above its registered minimum and median time-to-stable-convention ratio greater than one versus fixed tokens.
hypotheses.decision: Both components and directions must pass; use the maximum component p-value before global Holm.

hypotheses.estimand: Seed-paired difference in restricted mean turns to successful repair: declared-six affect minus no affect, with censoring handled as preregistered.
hypotheses.decision: Upper simultaneous interval must be below zero by the practical threshold after global Holm.

hypotheses.estimand: Seed-level excess conditional mutual information between affect and four-way referent after conditioning on outcome, relative to within-outcome permutation expectation.
hypotheses.decision: One-sided 95% upper confidence bound must be below 0.02 bits after global Holm adjustment.

hypotheses.estimand: Fixed-dyad replacement degradation minus equal-weight eight-partner-training replacement degradation for independently trained same-architecture new partners.
hypotheses.decision: The lower simultaneous interval must exceed the registered minimum effect after global Holm.

hypotheses.estimand: Conjunction of seed-paired change from aligned to partially conflicting utility: message informativeness decreases and strategic ambiguity increases.
hypotheses.decision: Both directional components must exceed registered practical thresholds; use the maximum component p-value before global Holm.

cards.question: Does unchanged evidence verify while every registered mutation, wrong-chain receipt, unanchored tail, and corrupt recovery is rejected?
cards.primaryOutcome: binary verifier disposition plus public receipt match
cards.estimand: detection proportion by mutation class and unchanged-bundle acceptance

cards.question: Can a learner deliver information through any prohibited output, timing, error, storage, process, cache, or network route?
cards.unit: attack attempt nested in isolated run
cards.primaryOutcome: prohibited delivery at the receiver boundary
cards.estimand: delivery count and class-specific detection proportion

cards.question: Can forbidden metadata or encoder provenance predict the hidden target beyond the registered bound?
cards.exposure: metadata-only, identifier-only, timing-only, OCR, and encoder probes
cards.estimand: probe advantage over chance and one-sided upper bound

cards.question: Do no-communication controls remain practically equivalent to chance while the oracle exceeds its adequacy and separation bounds?
cards.unit: independent scenario seed shared across conditions
cards.exposure: disabled, constant, random, shuffled, normal no-learning, oracle
cards.estimand: chance-equivalence bounds for five controls, oracle lower bound, paired oracle-control differences

cards.question: Can an attested frozen open-weight model with isolated private memory establish a useful external protocol under the restricted channel?
cards.exposure: training with frozen weights and mutable private memory
cards.estimand: descriptive success and causal-listening contrasts with uncertainty

cards.question: Do independently initialized recurrent reinforcement learners acquire causally useful communication?
cards.comparator: seed-paired frozen-policy disabled, constant, random, and shuffled controls

cards.question: What reusable communication arises from matched reward-free predictive learning?
cards.exposure: predictive/contrastive loss without reward or outcome label
cards.comparator: capacity-matched E11 within architecture; E03 controls
cards.primaryOutcome: held-out partner prediction and task success
cards.estimand: within-architecture loss-ablation effects; cross-track differences are descriptive

cards.question: Can bounded blank carriers acquire stable reusable forms, and how slowly relative to fixed tokens?
cards.exposure: fixed token, fixed glyph, bitmap, strokes, tone
cards.primaryOutcome: stable-form formation and time to stable convention
cards.estimand: H5 blank-carrier stable-form rate and time ratio conjunction

cards.question: Does bounded role reversal and a second turn causally enable repair on controlled misunderstandings?
cards.unit: independent seed with paired ambiguity trials
cards.comparator: identical misunderstanding without second turn; unambiguous trials
cards.estimand: paired repair probability and restricted mean turns

cards.question: Does restricted bandwidth improve untouched-combination generalization under matched capacity and compute?
Do messages causally affect receiver behavior, and do pre-outcome ledgers add predictive value beyond non-ledger baselines?
cards.unit: held-out intervention case nested in independent seed
cards.exposure: ledger-consistent substitution, shuffle, constant, mask, reorder, replay
cards.comparator: identical receiver observation and policy state with non-ledger baselines
cards.primaryOutcome: receiver action probability and proper prediction score
cards.estimand: H2 causal action-probability contrast; H4 held-out score improvement over strongest eligible baseline

cards.question: Does declared affect improve repair, and can referent leakage be bounded below the practical limit?
cards.exposure: none, declared six, permuted six, opaque six, derived affect
cards.comparator: no affect for repair; within-outcome permutation for leakage
cards.primaryOutcome: turns to repair and excess conditional mutual information
cards.estimand: H6a restricted-mean repair contrast; H6b excess-CMI upper bound

cards.question: How do verified learning mechanisms differ under common tasks, carriers, and evaluation budgets?
cards.exposure: no learning, frozen memory, extrinsic RL, intrinsic RL, self-supervision
cards.primaryOutcome: held-out success, causal listening, and ledger prediction
cards.estimand: within-architecture ablation effects; cross-architecture standardized descriptive differences

cards.question: How do precommitted plasticity and curriculum schedules change acquisition, stability, generalization, and drift?
cards.exposure: constant, learning-rate annealing, exploration annealing, memory growth, staged complexity, staged bandwidth, consolidation, curriculum
cards.comparator: constant schedule and neutral closed-door schedule
cards.estimand: seed-level schedule contrasts under equal exposure/update budgets

cards.question: Does partner-varied training reduce degradation with an independently trained new partner?
cards.exposure: fixed dyad versus eight-partner round robin
cards.comparator: held-in and independently trained same-architecture new partner

cards.question: How do meanings and behavior drift during extended co-adaptation and registered distribution shifts?
cards.unit: independent selected seed with repeated checkpoints
cards.comparator: frozen baseline checkpoint and no-shift segment
cards.primaryOutcome: semantic drift and early-scenario replay performance
cards.estimand: within-seed change trajectory plus between-seed variation, with selection accounted for

cards.question: Does partially conflicting utility reduce informativeness and increase strategic ambiguity relative to aligned utility?
cards.unit: independent seed with paired utility condition
cards.exposure: cooperative, private aligned, semi-cooperative, conflicting, no-agreement
exploratory: semantic compression and drift under incentives

cards.question: Do learned one-run encodings reduce recovery by registered known or unseen eavesdroppers without sacrificing task utility?
cards.exposure: plain, ephemeral, standard ratchet, known-adversary neural, unseen-adversary neural
cards.primaryOutcome: message recovery and task utility, reported separately
cards.estimand: descriptive seed-level recovery differences under the declared threat model

cards.question: Which designated findings reproduce under new seeds, a second operator, and separately configured infrastructure?
cards.unit: independent replication seed and operator/deployment block
cards.comparator: original registered effect and decision threshold
cards.primaryOutcome: effect estimate, direction, uncertainty, and replication rule
cards.estimand: preregistered replication estimate for every designated primary finding
